provenance: Enumerated from RI-JRN05 §B, which is binding. This file is the SPECIFICATION; game/src/save/state.js is the implementation. RI-JRN05 M4 is a set-difference in BOTH directions between this file and the key set of canonicalise(saveState()) — a field in the save that is not here is a defect, and a field here that is not in the save is a defect.

rules.V1: The volatile list is CLOSED. A field that differs across a round trip and is not on it is a defect. Moving a field onto it to make a test pass is falsification under RI-MTH04, not a fix.

groups.note: Every skill's current value AND its accumulated use-progress fraction (RI-JRN05 §B) — character.skills entries are {value, use_progress}.
Each stack: id, count, condition, charge, stolen, owner_of_record, equipped_slot, quick_slot. Sorted by id.
Per quest: stage, branch, failed, giver_disposition_delta, time_limit_in_frames, flags{}.
Append-only; order is SEMANTIC and indices are stable (journal.entry.numbering / RI-DLG05). Renumbering or reordering across a round trip is RI-JRN05 HF7.
Witness IDENTITIES, not a count — RI-JRN05 M8 and 'How we lose' #4.

Existence, position, soul quantity and which death it belongs to. Semantics are RI-JRN06's; survival across a save is this item's. `death.bloodstain` is a nullable RECORD and is therefore a declared dynamic container in rules.dynamic_containers: the manifest set-difference stops at it rather than treating its three fields as three separate manifest entries that vanish whenever there is no bloodstain.
Animation timers are stored as FRAME-RELATIVE offsets, because the current frame index is declared volatile. Storing absolute frame indices would make the round-trip hash depend on when you saved.
The seed AND the draw counter. A load that resets the draw counter is a determinism break (HARNESS.md D5) and is RI-JRN05 M5 / HF1.
CLOSED. Nothing may be added without an amendment to RI-JRN05.

declared_incomplete.note: Groups whose OWNING SYSTEM does not exist in wave 1 are present here and in the save as real, empty, round-tripping containers — not omitted. quests{} is empty because no quest runtime exists (owner: wave-1 pieces W1-14..W1-16), not because quest state is unsaved. RI-JRN05's five scenarios SV1-SV5 exercise late-game state; game/data/states/ ships sv1 and sv5 as fixtures so the round trip is measured against non-trivial state rather than a fresh character (RI-JRN05 'How we lose' #14).
